recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue; any future change to ConceptMap context semantics should be handled by a new Vocabulary work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-14685 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue for STU3 ConceptMap. It questioned why ConceptMap mappings are value-set-specific and proposed defining mappings only in the context of source and destination code systems. The accepted resolution clarified that mappings are intended in a particular business usage, normally defined by source and target value sets, and retained an example showing why context matters.
initial_application: The issue was pre-applied in SVN revision 13358, represented in git by fed48b46b1cb32a986d70fd4c69d9b569a0aab61, which changed ConceptMap narrative and definitions to use source/target value-set context and added the SNOMED CT to ICD-10 data-analysis-versus-billing example. A follow-up GF#14685 commit, 6d764b49297ea32917d13c2b9cc7bdb413a6d413, applied the final first-sentence replacement about business usage.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. Later R5-era ConceptMap changes renamed source/target to sourceScope/targetScope, but current sourceScope and targetScope definitions still describe value sets as providing mapping context. Confluence block-vote evidence matches the Jira disposition, and direct Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ConceptMap introduction already contains the final FHIR-14685 wording, the context-sensitive example, and the all-codes value-set caveat. Current StructureDefinition source also remains consistent with the resolution.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same historical SVN revision but concerned ConceptMap.group.unmapped wording; it is already represented on the combined branch by 7893c3da1f49d3b8aed585e1618dc7e18cdb550a.
